description: Digest of a company's material current reports (Form 8-K) over roughly the trailing five quarters, read from the filings and their exhibits: earnings releases, management changes, capital returns, debt offerings and governance actions, each citing its SEC accession number. Returns the full digest by default; it is short. Pass a section to narrow it.

section.description: Optional section name, matched case-insensitively on a prefix.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b.

name: get_events
title: 8-K filings and material events
